{{Infobox auto}}
The '''archeologist's brush''' is an unbreakable [[Archaeology|brush]] sold by the [[Archaeologist|archaeologist]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A level 2 archaeologist sells it for one [[Obol|obol]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/cartographer/2/brush.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It works like a normal brush but never breaks. The name is spelled "Archeologist's" in game.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.12.4|The item updater turned any plain brush held in either hand into an archeologist's brush, so crafted brushes became unbreakable.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/mainhand/brush.json|at=acec32328368f3985c45f8077732d92a664f3d13}}</ref>}}
{{History line|1.12.8-beta|date=October 23, 2026|Plain brushes are no longer turned into archeologist's brushes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha_item/predicate/mainhand/brush.json}}</ref>}}
}}
